resources.string: Coffer talks to Telegram with your own API keys, so no one else\'s app stands between you and your files.

1. Open my.telegram.org and sign in with your phone number.
2. Go to API development tools.
3. Create an application (any title and short name).
4. Copy App api_id and App api_hash here.
Enter your phone number with the country code. Your files will be stored, encrypted, in your Saved Messages.
Sign in with a QR code instead
On a phone where you are signed in, open Telegram, go to Settings, Devices, Link Desktop Device, and scan this code.
We sent the code to your Telegram app on another device. It comes as a message from Telegram, in the chat named Telegram with a blue check mark.
We sent the code by SMS to %1$s.
You will get a call to %1$s with the code.
The code was sent to your anonymous number on Fragment.
Enter the code Telegram sent you.

It can take a minute. Look in every app where you use Telegram, on a phone or a computer. Each new code makes the one before it stop working, and starting over too often can get sign-in blocked for a while. If no code comes, sign in with a QR code instead, scanned with Telegram on another phone or tablet.
Telegram asks for an email address to send sign-in codes to.
Your account is protected with a password. Enter your Telegram cloud password.
This number has no Telegram account. Create one in the official Telegram app first, then sign in here.
Telegram asks for a Premium subscription before this sign-in. That can only be done in the official Telegram app.
Reset Telegram data and try again
api_id is a number and api_hash is 32 characters of 0-9 and a-f.
Too many attempts. Telegram asks to wait %1$s.
This phone number is not valid.
Telegram has banned this phone number.
The code has expired. Start over to get a new one.
Telegram does not accept these API keys.
Telegram has blocked these API keys. Create new ones at my.telegram.org.
An encrypted file vault in your Telegram Saved Messages. Files, names and folders are encrypted on this phone before anything is sent; Telegram only stores blobs it cannot read.
Coffer talks to Telegram through the official Telegram API with your own account. There is no Coffer server.
Your files will show up in Saved Messages as files named like cfr_1a2b3c4d5e6f.bin. Do not delete them in the regular Telegram app, or the files they belong to will be lost.
Checking Saved Messages for a Coffer vault.
Enter the vault password. It is not your Telegram password.
Enter the 24 words you wrote down when the vault was created, separated by spaces.
No vault was found in your Saved Messages. Choose a password for a new one. Anyone who gets into your Telegram account could try to guess it, so make it strong: a few unrelated words work well.

These 24 words open your vault if you forget the password. Write them down on paper, in order, and keep them somewhere safe. Anyone with these words can open your vault. You can see them again later in Settings, after entering the password.
I have written down all 24 words
Type these words from your paper copy.

Open the vault with your fingerprint or face instead of typing the password every time. The phone\'s PIN does not open it. The vault key stays in this phone\'s secure hardware and is lost if a new fingerprint or face is added; then the password is needed once.
Some words are not in the recovery word list.
These words are not a valid recovery key. Check for a misspelled or swapped word.
This recovery key belongs to a different vault.
These words do not match. Check your paper copy, or show the words again.
A vault was just created from another device. Unlock that one instead.
Could not unlock with the fingerprint. Use the password.
Fingerprint unlock was reset, for example because a new fingerprint or face was added. Unlock with the password once.
